title: ❓ Специальные вопросы о праздниках
description: Вставь вопросительное слово, чтобы получился правильный специальный вопрос.

items.sentence: ___ does my family celebrate New Year?
items.hint: My family celebrates New Year in the evening.

items.sentence: ___ clothes does she wear on festivals?
___ does he carry in his pocket?
items.hint: He carries a lucky charm in his pocket.

items.sentence: ___ often do they take part in a parade?
items.hint: They take part in a parade every spring.

items.sentence: ___ do we make for the party?
items.hint: We make decorations for the party.

items.sentence: ___ does our school organise on special days?
items.hint: Our school organises concerts on special days.

items.sentence: ___ do you feel before the festival?
items.hint: I feel excited before the festival.
